## Momentus Enterprise

**CORE**

**What you can expect**

Unifies lead capture, contracting, event details, and service execution so teams stop chasing updates across spreadsheets.

Delivers cleaner handoffs, fewer day-of surprises, and faster billing with AR basics in place.

**What this tier delivers**

- Reduce rework from spreadsheets and email threads
- Keep event details consistent from booking through day-of execution
- Improve visibility across calendars, spaces, and services

**Included capabilities**

- Leads
- Contacts and Accounts
- Calendars
- Event Opportunities
- Proposals and Contracts
- Functions
- Service Orders
- Work Order Management
- Change Tracking
- Basic Inventory
- AR Invoices
- AR Collections
- AR Payments
- Payment Portal

- Reports
- Audit Ready GL Export
- Single Sign-On, back office

- _Optional Addon: Momentus Connect APIs, Basic, Standard, OData_

**What upgrading to Pro adds**

Upgrading to Enterprise Pro adds sales and operational management depth to Core so teams standardize how work moves, reduce handoffs, and run each event with tighter control from pipeline through delivery.

- Reduce finance rework with budgeting and general ledger structure

## Expand Your Enterprise Workflows

Explore workflow bundles to extend your Enterprise platform in the areas you need most.

Exhibitor Management Bundle

Stop exhibitor ordering and coordination chaos. Start a unified exhibitor workflow for intake, selling, planning, execution, and billing. Outcome: higher exhibitor satisfaction and more revenue capture.

- Exhibitor Portal
- Admin Portal
- Co-Exhibitors & Contractors
- Exhibition Floor Plan
- Show Map
- Advanced Exhibitor Categorization
- Pavilion & Section Management
- Exhibitor Registration
- Exhibitor Sales & Records

Registration Bundle

Stop cleaning lists and chasing payments. Start registration, tickets, add-ons, attendee data, and payments in one flow. Outcome: higher conversion and fewer onsite issues.

- Automatic Waitlisting
- Camp Registration
- Continuing Education Units
- Online Conference Housing Registration
- Online Registration Check-In
- RCI App
- Registration - Premium
- Shopping Cart Registration
- Session Proposals

Booking Bundle

Stop calendar drift and double booking. Start structured availability, holds, pricing, proposals, and contracts in one workspace. Outcome: faster booking cycles and cleaner handoffs.

- Outlook Calendar Integration
- Online Space Booking
- Account Management Portal
- Online Event Ordering

Self Service Bundle

Stop intake and approvals living in email. Start branded self-serve request, e-sign, pay, and status tracking. Outcome: fewer follow ups and faster conversion.

- Exhibitor Sales & Records
- Exhibitor Service Center
- Event Portal

Momentus Connect API Bundle

Stop manual exports and data silos. Start secure, documented APIs to sync event, space, customer, and financial data. Outcome: reliable integrations and less rekeying.

- Basic
- Standard
- OData

[Connect with a Momentus representative](https://gomomentus.com/request-demo)

How pricing works

- Pricing aligns to scope and usage, not headcount.
- Pricing factors in total number of events to adhere to value-add for your venue.
- Total cost includes base tier, onboarding, plus optional add-ons when workflow scope expands.

Shared across tiers

- Unlimited use with Role-based access and governance controls
- Standard reporting foundations
- In-product guidance plus optional AI data add-ons for deeper analysis

Who fits

- Venues managing sales, event operations, and finance across multiple teams
- Organizations needing reporting across spaces, venue, and utilization
- Multi-venue groups, or single venues with exhibitions, accounting, or complex governance needs

Who does not fit

- Single-room booking for small offices with no event revenue workflows
- Registration-only event platforms with no venue operations and finance needs

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Momentus pricing for venue and event management software?

Momentus pricing is quote-based and packaged by tier. Momentus Enterprise offers Core, Pro, and Premier tiers. Momentus Elite offers Pro, Premier, and Premier Plus tiers. Your quote is based on venue count, annual event volume, workflow scope, integrations, and onboarding needs. A Momentus representative provides a tier recommendation and a written quote outline after a short scope review.

### How much does venue management software cost with Momentus?

[Venue management software](https://gomomentus.com/) cost with Momentus depends on scope. The biggest drivers are number of venues, annual definite events or booking volume, sales and finance workflow needs, integration requirements, and data migration complexity. Add-ons like WeTrack, Analytics, Ask Mo Data, Payments, Operations Hub, Booking Portal, DocuSign, and EventDraw Room Diagramming are also quoted based on scope and usage.

### What drives Momentus Enterprise pricing?

Momentus Enterprise pricing is driven by venue complexity and event volume, plus the workflows you need across sales, event operations, and finance. The quote also reflects integrations, reporting needs, security requirements like SSO, and migration scope. Enterprise tiers scale from Core to Pro to Premier based on finance depth and venue requirements.

### **Is Momentus priced per user or per seat?**

No. Momentus packages support unlimited users, so pricing is not based on seat count. This reduces adoption friction across departments. During quoting, you still define roles, permissions, and training groups so governance and onboarding match how teams work.

### What add-ons and integrations are available for Momentus Enterprise?

Enterprise add-ons extend outcomes based on scope. Payments supports online payments, credits, refunds, and settlement workflows when configured. WeTrack supports risk and incident workflows. Analytics supports executive reporting and benchmarking where available. Ask Mo Data supports conversational analysis for approved datasets. Enterprise can also add Booking Portal, DocuSign, and EventDraw Room Diagramming when self-service, signature flow, or diagramming is required. Integration scope through Momentus Connect and Marketplace apps affects onboarding effort and pricing.

### **What is included in a Momentus quote?**

A Momentus quote typically includes your base tier, onboarding and training scope, required integrations, and any selected add-ons. The quote outline also clarifies data migration scope, timeline assumptions, and what is included versus optional.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Momentus pricing for venue and event management software?

Momentus pricing is quote-based and packaged by tier. Momentus Enterprise offers Core, Pro, and Premier tiers. Momentus Elite offers Pro, Premier, and Premier Plus tiers. Your quote is based on venue count, annual event volume, workflow scope, integrations, and onboarding needs. A Momentus representative provides a tier recommendation and a written quote outline after a short scope review.

### How much does venue management software cost with Momentus?

[Venue management software](https://gomomentus.com/) cost with Momentus depends on scope. The biggest drivers are number of venues, annual definite events or booking volume, sales and finance workflow needs, integration requirements, and data migration complexity. Add-ons like WeTrack, Analytics, Ask Mo Data, Payments, Operations Hub, Booking Portal, DocuSign, and EventDraw Room Diagramming are also quoted based on scope and usage.

### **What drives Momentus Elite pricing?**

Momentus Elite pricing is driven by booking and scheduling complexity, event volume, invoicing and payments needs, operational visibility, and required integrations. The quote also reflects onboarding scope and migration needs. Elite tiers scale from Pro to Premier to Premier Plus as you add quoting structure, invoicing, and payment workflows.

### **Is Momentus priced per user or per seat?**

No. Momentus packages support unlimited users, so pricing is not based on seat count. This reduces adoption friction across departments. During quoting, you still define roles, permissions, and training groups so governance and onboarding match how teams work.

### **What add-ons and integrations are available for Momentus Elite?**

Elite add-ons extend execution and finance outcomes. Payments supports online payments, credits, refunds, and settlement workflows when configured. Operations Hub supports day-of coordination and visibility. WeTrack supports risk workflows. Elite can also add Booking Portal, DocuSign, and EventDraw Room Diagramming when intake, approvals, signature flow, or diagramming is required. Integration scope through Momentus Connect and Marketplace apps affects onboarding effort and pricing.

### **What is included in a Momentus quote?**

A Momentus quote typically includes your base tier, onboarding and training scope, required integrations, and any selected add-ons. The quote outline also clarifies data migration scope, timeline assumptions, and what is included versus optional.
